# Cortex Bridge

> Local Python/FastAPI bridge between a ChatGPT web conversation and reviewed
> workspace execution. Optional Atelier GUI and French terminal share one
> backend. No OpenAI API key is used by the Chrome-extension transport.

## Status

- Source candidate: 0.6.1; not a verified live or installed release.
- Consult the current evidence report before asserting readiness.
- Automated fixtures are not authenticated ChatGPT observations.
- Mission execution is deterministic: ChatGPT model selection changes the planner,
  not a local LLM executor. Freebuff is not a connected mission backend.
- Do not infer model quality, free/unlimited quotas or provider authorization.
- Respect installer plan-hash approval, browser consent and per-action policy.
- Never enter credentials, bypass browser controls or retry ambiguous sends.

## Entry points

- `console/server.py`: Python/FastAPI local service, normally 127.0.0.1:8420.
- `chrome-extension/`: Chrome MV3 transport, not an `extension/` directory.
- `scripts/cortex`: source terminal wrapper; `scripts/cortex ui` opens the GUI.
- `scripts/cortex.sh`: managed lifecycle, doctor and selftest.
- `frontend/`: static React/Next.js GUI.
- `orchestration/` and `executor/`: mission state machine and local tools.
- `CORTEX_HOME`: runtime storage outside the source checkout.

## Agent guidance

Do not install or start anything solely because this file mentions a command.
First inspect the actual checkout and runtime. Explain proposed installations
and permissions to the user and obtain approval. Keep secrets, account data and
local identity paths out of logs, screenshots, commits and public reports.
